event_summary: A small yellow round object appears near the upper part of a panel, moves downward through the arrangement of colored strips, and then remains on a central purple bent strip.
raw_event_description: The scene begins with a vertical pale panel containing several colored flat strips and black side supports. After several still frames, a small yellow round object becomes visible below the upper green curved strip. It changes position downward and to the right, passes near the upper purple dotted horizontal strip, then moves lower toward the central purple bent strip. In the later frames the yellow object is visible on the purple bent strip and stays in the same visible place while the surrounding strips remain unchanged.

reasons: The panel, supports, and colored strips are visible in the first frame.
The small yellow moving object is not visible in the first frame.
